name: Cheerleader
source:
Summer is offered to apply for cheerleading team. She needs to practice to be ready to participate. Help your as her roommate to practice and get ready for cheerleading. As she improves her skills you'll hand over new assignments to her. Who knows, maybe you'll keep enjoying your "practices" when she gets pro?
Join Summer on her journey!

[From the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/cheerleader-is-68412148]Patreon post[/url]]
translation:
Summer获邀报名加入啦啦队，需要练习才能做好参选准备。身为她的室友，帮她训练，为啦啦队选拔作准备吧。随着她的技巧进步，你将交给她新的练习任务。谁知道呢，也许等她成为高手，你们还是会继续享受这些“练习”？
与Summer一同踏上这段旅程！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/cheerleader-is-68412148]Patreon帖子[/url]]
